RumorFact.Text: I found recordings about someone named Bouderi making a discovery that was dismissed by his peers.
I found recordings of someone named Calveryi following up on Bouderi's research.
I spoke to Brevipes in the past and told him about the notes on radiation.

ExploreFact.Text: I entered the dome in the future after speaking to Brevipes and found a vial of some sort of gas in good condition.
There's an asteroid at the bottom of Kanaloa's Rest.
The asteroid is cracked and has a green light spilling out of it.
It seems that some villagers that were sent into the past tried to create a device to reverse the asteroid's effects, but failed

RumorFact.Text: The vial looks like it can fit on the table.
The heart looks like it can fit on the table.
The crystal looks like it can fit on the table.
I found recordings about a table used for both assembly and medical purposes.

ExploreFact.Text: I found a table with mechanical assistance tools.

RumorFact.Text: There's a large dome near one of the villages

ExploreFact.Text: There's a large dome near an underwater village.
The door is locked but a screen beside it allows me to speak to a village inhabitant named "Brevipes"
Brevipes seemed paranoid of sharing the same fate of their ancestors.
Brevipes mentioned an asteroid but I can't see any nearby.
I was able to enter the dome in the future through a hole in the glass but there's no sign of life inside.

RumorFact.Text: There might be something in the water that the Nomai never saw

ExploreFact.Text: There are villages under the water on Kanaloa's Depths.
I found a recording talking about malfunctioning technology, the species that lived here are called "Chronalopods".
I found a recording talking about some village inhabitants stealing equipment from a few Nomai that landed on one of the largest islands.
The surface appears to be made up of floating rock islands.
I found Nomai text on a large island talking about wanting to explore underwater, before their equipment disappeared.
I found a nursery building semisubmerged within the water.
